reviewMethod: Bounded R5 F1/C5 correction: read the seven named sections in frozen REC context. Register one inheritance statement and six lowercase advisories, not a general natural-language completeness classification or independent acceptance.

constraints.reason: In all other respects dc:contributor inherits dc:creator requirements, while p1 identifies a secondary role. Preserve this qualified reference to the creator family with its original optional refinements, conditional advice and order semantics; do not duplicate it into a new mandatory creator-role rule or reinterpret a contributor as the primary creator.
constraints.applicability: Package dc:contributor metadata for secondary contributors; inherited creator rules retain their respective conditions and levels.
constraints.phase: T2 metadata model; T3 migration; T4a metadata maintenance; S2-S4 presentation

constraints.reason: Lowercase should advises maximal unique-identifier persistence and avoiding new identifiers for minor metadata/errata revisions. This is not a BCP14 MUST or a ban on identifiers changing for significant revisions; the existing marked uniqueness/id-reference requirements remain separate.
constraints.applicability: EPUB creator identifier maintenance, distinguishing minor changes from significant revisions.
constraints.phase: T2 metadata identity; T3 migration; T4a metadata maintenance

constraints.reason: Lowercase should advises expressing additional dates using specialized dcterms properties or similar. It does not require extra dates, prescribe dcterms exclusively, or replace the separate dc:date cardinality MUST NOT and recommended format.
constraints.applicability: Additional package dates, distinct from publication date and last modification date.
constraints.phase: T2 metadata model; T3 migration; T4a metadata maintenance

constraints.reason: Lowercase should recommends a human-readable subject heading/label, but permits a code when the taxonomy provides no separate descriptive label. Do not require inventing a label or forbid code-only taxonomies; marked scheme/term rules and scheme-dependent case sensitivity remain separate.
constraints.applicability: Subject value authoring, including taxonomies lacking an independent descriptive label.
constraints.phase: T2 metadata model; T3 migration; T4a metadata maintenance

constraints.reason: Lowercase should advises updating the last modified date whenever the publication changes. It is not a new BCP14 MUST and does not replace the separately marked cardinality, ISO format, UTC/Z or additional-subject requirements.
constraints.applicability: EPUB creator modification-date maintenance when changing the publication.
constraints.phase: T2 metadata model; T4a metadata maintenance

constraints.reason: If the media table lists multiple types, the first is preferred; lowercase should recommends that preferred type for new publications. This neither forbids the other listed types nor replaces the core-resource/fallback rules or claims codec support.
constraints.applicability: Selecting manifest media types for new publications; ordered preference within a multi-type table entry.
constraints.phase: T2 media profiles; T4a manifest maintenance; S2-S4 resources

constraints.reason: When publishers/vendors must use DRM, lowercase should prefers schemes that do not use/transmit user or content information to external parties for encryption/decryption. The lowercase must is a condition, not an obligation to implement or use DRM; this remains privacy advice, not an executed capability.
constraints.applicability: Publishers/vendors choosing DRM only when they have to use it; privacy boundary for external encryption/decryption parties.
constraints.phase: T2 preserved resource/security metadata; S2-S4 optional DRM/privacy policy

sectionNotes.sec-opf-dccontributor: R5 F1 correction: read p1 secondary-role definition and p2 in-all-other-respects inheritance alongside all six creator paragraphs. Register p2 against the fixed p1 secondary-role context; inherit existing creator conditions/levels without forcing primary-creator identity or mandatory role refinements. No contributor behavior or full independent approval claimed.
sectionNotes.sec-opf-dcidentifier: R5 C5 correction: read p1-p5. Register p3 lowercase persistence/minor-revision advice; existing unique-identifier and id-reference MUSTs remain. Significant revisions are not classified as minor and advice is not upgraded to BCP14.
sectionNotes.sec-opf-dcdate: R5 C5 correction: read p1-p4. p3 recommends specialized dcterms or similar for additional dates, not additional dc:date elements. Publication date differs from modified date; existing format recommendation and cardinality prohibition retain identities.
sectionNotes.sec-opf-dcsubject: R5 C5 correction following R3: read p1-p5. Register p1 heading/label advice with code permitted when taxonomy lacks a separate label. Existing authority MAY, conditional scheme/term MUST/MUST NOT and p5 scheme-dependent case definition remain unchanged; neither universal case sensitivity nor mandatory invented labels.
sectionNotes.sec-metadata-last-modified: R5 C5 correction: read p1-p4 and examples. p3 lowercase should advises updates on changes; p1/p2 marked format/cardinality/UTC rules and p4 subject condition remain independent. Advice is not new BCP14 MUST or executed maintenance support.
sectionNotes.sec-core-media-types: R5 C5 correction: read p1-p3, column-description list and core media table. In media-type li1 p2 the first listed type is preferred when multiple types exist, with lowercase advice for new publications. Other listed types are not forbidden and preference does not replace existing spine fallback rules or demonstrate media decoding.
sectionNotes.security-privacy-recommendations: R5 C5 correction: read p1-p8 and practical-steps list. p7 is conditional privacy advice when publishers/vendors must use DRM, not a requirement to implement DRM. Existing uppercase tracking/storage/preservation advice retains levels and applicability. No DRM execution or real user-data processing claimed.
